note: Every official source czechia-law takes text from, what is read on it, how often, and whether it is watched (read on a schedule, each read recorded in data/checks/). tools/checktrail.py reads this file.

states.watched: read on its schedule; every read is a record in data/checks/
states.not-yet-watched: text was read when the folder was built; no scheduled read yet
states.paused: deliberately not read for now (the note says why)
states.closed: a closed collection: nothing new will be published
